PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 13, 2020

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, February 13,
2020, at 2:04 pm in the Community Room “A” 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Dept. (2:12)
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk’s Office
  Debra Crenshaw, City Treasures’ Office

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items
A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
January 23, 2020.

Special Permit Request(s):

Item #1:  Alexis Roberts DBA Center of Hope to host Alive in Inglewood at – Pincay
  Drive between Crenshaw and entrance of Renaissance, on Sunday, April
  12, 2020, from 10:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. (Activity No. 00295852);
  Item held over for further review.

New Tobacco Retailers License Request(s):

Item #2:  Michael A. Estrada DBA ICY MO'S MINI MART to operate as a tobacco
  retailer at 420 E Florence Ave.; subject to Standard Recommendations as
  follows: Sales of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco,
  hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly
  prohibited; persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products
  shall have valid identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products;
  “NO LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING”
  signage must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and
  cannabis products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of
  pipe used to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine,
 Permits & License Committee  February 13, 2020
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

  methamphetamine, including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped
  pipes used to smoke and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is
  permitted; sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords,
  knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco
  Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees is
  subject to random Permits & Licensing establishment inspections at any
  time of the day or night by any Police and Code Enforcement officers;
  purpose of random inspections is to enforce business establishments
  adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood and for
  Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events or gatherings of
  any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live bands/music, disc jockeys
  (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business owner(s) is required to operate
  within normal business hours; adhere to all applicable IMC rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried and second.
  (Activity No. 00296286)

Item #3:  Deep Sea Oil Inc. DBA Manchester Fuel to operate as a tobacco retailer at
  633 W Manchester Blvd.; subject to Standard Recommendations as
  follows: Sales of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco,
  hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly
  prohibited; persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products
  shall have valid identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products;
  “NO LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING”
  signage must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and
  cannabis products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of
  pipe used to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine,
  methamphetamine, including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped
  pipes used to smoke and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is
  permitted; sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords,
  knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco
  Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees is
  subject to random Permits & Licensing establishment inspections at any
  time of the day or night by any Police and Code Enforcement officers;
  purpose of random inspections is to enforce business establishments
  adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood and for
  Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events or gatherings of
  any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live bands/music, disc jockeys
  (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business owner(s) is required to operate
  within normal business hours; adhere to all applicable IMC rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried and second.
  (Activity No. 00296286)
